channel.title: Kitchen Line Crew: Pickleball Retirement Gifts
channel.description: New pins for the Pickleball Retirement Gifts board by Kitchen Line Crew.

item.title: Grandma Doesn't Cook Anymore She Dinks Pickleball Shirt, Gift for Retired Pickleball Players
item.description: “Grandma Doesn't Cook Anymore. She Dinks.” on a pickleball shirt. An easy birthday or Christmas gift for pickleball grandmas and anyone who lives at the kitchen line. Printed and shipped in the US. From the Kitchen Line Crew shop on Etsy.

item.title: Pickleball Rules for Beginners
item.description: Pickleball rules in plain English on two large-print pages: scoring and calling the score, the serve, the two-bounce rule, the kitchen and the 10 mistakes we see every week. Free to print.

item.title: Will Babysit After Pickleball Shirt, Gift for Retired Pickleball Players
item.description: “Will Babysit After Pickleball” on a pickleball shirt. An easy birthday or Christmas gift for pickleball grandmas and anyone who lives at the kitchen line. Printed and shipped in the US. From the Kitchen Line Crew shop on Etsy.
